checked.label: Step 1 actions (rev8 rewording)
problems: do[0] carries two ideas in one line (watch normally for a few days + do the step when a thought comes): one idea per line.
It lacks 'Don’t go looking for it.', which the alcohol page has and the owner's 9 Nov note asks for.

plan[0].do: Still watching? Don’t quit yet. For the next few days, watch the way you normally do.
When one of the thoughts above comes up, do the step under it. Don’t go looking for it.
Already stopped? Don’t start watching again to do this step: write it from memory.
Before each time, write one line: the hour, where you are, what you felt just before.
After, one more line: what it gave you, and what it cost.
Then write down what porn does for you: stress relief, sleep, boredom, loneliness.
Each one is a belief. Start with the beliefs above.
Circle what repeats. Those hours and feelings are what your swaps are for.
